build_sequence_scorer: build a SequenceScorer instance with a target dictionary and optional softmax batch size
score_translations: score a batch of translations using an ensemble of fairseq models and a sample
compute_alignment: compute word-level alignment between source and target tokens using attention weights
gather_target_probs: gather target token probabilities from decoder output using index gathering on the vocabulary dimension
batch_for_softmax: batch decoder output into chunks that fit within the softmax batch size limit
